finding: The prior deterministic modulo schedule repeated six production identities across twenty-four hours and therefore did not encode a distinct stage identity for every hour.

assertions: UTC hours are exactly 0 through 23 in ascending order.
Every hour has a unique edition_id ending in its two-digit UTC hour.
Every slot references a declared base production.
Every slot carries a non-empty edition_cue.
Motion, mobile, accessibility, performance, privacy, and commerce boundaries remain fail-closed.

observed: The canonical repertory contained six productions and repeated them by utc_hour % productions.length.
The operating instruction requires a distinct film, stage, or interface each hour.
The repository currently prohibits application deployment attempts while provider capacity is blocked.
provenance.inferred: A unique hourly edition can satisfy distinct programming without fabricating twenty-four unrelated base productions or fragmenting the continuity state.
provenance.experiment: Bind each UTC hour to a unique edition identity and cue while permitting deterministic reuse of the six proven base production grammars.
provenance.current_decision: Adopt deterministic_hour_slot with twenty-four unique edition identities as the canonical operations-only repertory contract.
